_about: Card / step text corrections found by the sūtra-level teaching review (audit/SUTRA-pilot-review.md), each with its source. Applied by build.js after all other passes. cards: {word, q?, ans?, drop?}; text: {find (regex), replace} on step texts, 'also at work' lines and credit texts.

7.2.35.why: The augment goes to the ārdhadhātuka, not to the aṅga — Mahābhāṣya on 7.2.35: “अङ्गस्येति वर्ततेऽङ्गविशेषणम् ॥ तत्र को दोषः ? ॥ अङ्गस्य वलादेरादित इट्प्रसज्येत - अडाड्वत् ।”

text.replace: अङ्गस्य (carried from 6.4.1): the heading is in force, but the augment does not go to the aṅga — the sūtra names आर्धधातुकस्य so that it goes to the suffix (Mahābhāṣya: “अङ्गस्य वलादेरादित इट्प्रसज्येत - अडाड्वत्”)

4.1.165.why: सपिण्डे … जीवति is a locative absolute (‘while another sapiṇḍa lives’), not a following element — Kāśikā: “भ्रातुरन्यस्मिन् सपिण्डे स्थविरतरे जीवति …”

text.replace: सपिण्डे → while (a locative absolute, with जीवति):

2.1.59.why: word-lists, not paired in order — Kāśikā: “श्रेणिकृताः। एककृताः।”

2.3.37.why: भावलक्षणम् names the other action that is marked, not a following element — Kāśikā: “यस्य च क्रियया क्रियान्तरं लक्ष्यते”

8.1.60.why: इति quotes the word ह; क्षिया is a meaning; the तिङ् keeps its accent — Kāśikā: “ह इत्यनेन युक्ता प्रथमा तिङ्विभक्तिर्नानुदात्ता भवति क्षियायां गम्यमानायाम्।”

text.find: इति: a particle — it joins the parts; the vṛtti does not need it as a word
text.replace: इति: quotes the word ह — the verb is the one joined with ह (Kāśikā: “ह इत्यनेन युक्ता”)

text.find: तिङ्: not so \(1\.1\.49\) — 1\.1\.49 does not operate here \(paribhāṣā audit\)
text.replace: तिङ् → the first finite verb (it is not made anudātta)

5.3.4.why: the pairing is of the two substitutes with the two following sounds (एत before र, इत् before थ) — Kāśikā: “रेफथकारादौ … इदम एतेतावादेशौ भवतः”

text.find: 2 forms and 2 meanings → paired in order \(yathāsaṅkhya\)
text.replace: 2 substitutes (एत, इत्) and 2 following sounds (र, थ) → paired in order (yathāsaṅkhya): एत before र, इत् before थ

6.2.65.why: the accent falls on the first vowel of the pūrvapada; nothing is replaced — Kāśikā: “पूर्वपदं … आद्युदात्तं भवति”

q: which member takes the accent on its first vowel?

text.find: पूर्वपदम्: not so \(1\.1\.49\) — 1\.1\.49 does not operate here \(paribhāṣā audit\)
text.replace: पूर्वपदम् → the member that takes the accent (on its first vowel)

8.3.4.why: the step's word is the augment अनुस्वारः — Kāśikā: “ततः परोऽनुस्वार आगमो भवति”

1.3.52.why: the carried ग्रः is गॄ निगरणे (tudādi, गिरति) — Kāśikā on 1.3.51: “गॄ निगरणे (धा० पा० १४१०) इति तुदादौ पठ्यते, तस्येदं ग्रहणम्”

text.replace: → the base: “गृ-धातोः” = गॄ निगरणे (तुदादि, गिरति; Kāśikā on 1.3.51)
